renderingStrategy: Prefer build-time Canvas-generated spritesheets exported as PNG; fallback to cached offscreen atlas drawn once, not vector shapes each frame.
notIncluded: Actual PNG/WAV assets are not generated in this planning package; Opus will create them later.
fixNotes: v0.9 W_01/W_02/W_03 species IDs were reused across land/fish/marine; now globally unique ANIMAL_*, FISH_*, MARINE_*
No sprite or audio assets are created by this package

assetBuildPolicy.delivery: Use local generated art, no network dependency, no brand/game copied sprites; at build time produce PNG atlas or cache offscreen Canvas once
assetBuildPolicy.imageLoadError: Show explicit blocking error with path; never silently use missing texture or emoji
assetBuildPolicy.validation: Check generated PNG dimensions, alpha, path uniqueness and actual presence before release
assetBuildPolicy.fallbackForWeakDevices: reduce overlay particles, weather fx and offscreen objects; preserve essential visuals and gameplay
